'''0.14d''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that transitioned the client to a production version (as opposed to debugging) and fixed some connection crashes.

==Changelog==
* Game launch files compiled into "master gold" version. Increased productivity. Debugging console commands are no longer available.

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed game crashes part that occurred when connecting to a new match
